item.text: The parser already checks whole-input UTF-8 and handles basic comment stripping, but it currently normalizes lone CR bytes, permits control characters outside strings, and does not validate the raw key/comment regions before parsing. I’m tightening those lexical checks at the decode boundary and adding package tests for valid comments, permitted tabs/newlines, invalid controls, invalid UTF-8, and statement separation.
